snippet.title: Ugly Americans: Apocalypsegeddon   (PS3)
snippet.description: Ugly Americans: Apocalypsegeddon is a twin-stick shoot 'em up video game based on the Comedy Central television show Ugly Americans. The game was released for PlayStation 3 on August 30, 2011 and for Xbox 360 on August 31, 2011.
